facts.fact: The Public Market is indoors, with food, produce, farmers stalls and locally made handcrafted products.
Studios, theatres, restaurants and other businesses keep their own hours; visitors should check individual directory listings.
facts.location: Artist studios, theatres, restaurants & bars, events and all other businesses, please check our directory listings and individual websites for hours.
